title: Jailer 2 Hindi Version Falls Short Of Hit Verdict Despite Strong Run
excerpt: Koimoi says the Hindi-dubbed Jailer 2 has reached Rs 50.3 crore net in 24 days, Rs 1.7 crore short of the Rs 52 crore it says the version needed for a Hit verdict.
body:
• Koimoi reports the Hindi-dubbed version of Jailer 2 has earned Rs 50.3 crore net in India in 24 days, against the Rs 52 crore net Koimoi says it needed for a Hit verdict.
  • Koimoi says the film is therefore likely to finish with a Plus verdict, Rs 1.7 crore short of the Hit mark, after its shows fell sharply following the arrival of Ramayana.
  • Jailer 2 is a Tamil-language film directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, starring Rajinikanth, and was released theatrically on October 15, 2026.
  • Across all languages, trade tracker Sacnilk figures reported by Filmibeat put the film at Rs 459.70 crore net in India after 19 days, with a worldwide gross of Rs 812 crore.

The Hindi-dubbed version of Jailer 2 is set to miss a clean Hit verdict at the Indian box office, according to Koimoi, despite a run the publication describes as stronger than expected for a version released with little promotion from the makers.

Koimoi reports that the Hindi version has earned Rs 50.3 crore net in India in 24 days, equivalent to Rs 59.35 crore gross. Based on the valuation of its theatrical rights, Koimoi says the version needed Rs 52 crore net to secure a Hit verdict. That leaves a gap of Rs 1.7 crore, which Koimoi says is now out of reach as collections have slowed, so the Hindi version is expected to conclude with a Plus verdict instead.

How the Hindi run built, then slowed

Koimoi's week-wise breakdown shows where the total came from. The Hindi version earned Rs 30.65 crore net in its first week, counted over eight days, followed by Rs 13.15 crore in week two and Rs 6.35 crore in week three. By day 23 it was adding Rs 5 lakh, and on day 24, its fourth Saturday, it rose to Rs 10 lakh, according to Koimoi.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=FW_PPcr1sPE

The slowdown, Koimoi says, followed the arrival of Ramayana. The publication reports that the film's shows in Hindi fell from 3,428 to 103 after that release, and that daily collections dropped from Rs 65 lakh on day 21 to Rs 5 lakh on day 22. Collections are still coming in, Koimoi adds, but on the lower side.

Koimoi's own summary puts the Hindi version's cost at Rs 26 crore, its India net at Rs 50.3 crore, and its return on investment at Rs 24.3 crore, or 93.46 percent, with a Plus verdict. Those figures, and the Hit threshold itself, are Koimoi's assessment, not an official figure from the producers.

The wider picture across languages

The Hindi result is only one part of a much larger all-language run. Reporting trade tracker Sacnilk's estimates, Filmibeat said the film collected Rs 3.40 crore net across all languages in India on day 19, November 2, taking its cumulative India net to Rs 459.70 crore and its domestic gross to Rs 537.75 crore. Filmibeat reported an overseas gross of Rs 274.25 crore at that point, for an estimated worldwide total of Rs 812 crore after 19 days.

That context matters for diaspora audiences, who have largely watched the film in its original Tamil version or in Telugu, Kannada and Hindi versions in overseas markets. The Hindi-dubbed performance is a separate, narrower story: a dubbed version that, on Koimoi's numbers, nearly doubled its stated Rs 26 crore cost in net collections, even if it stops short of the publication's Hit line.

About the film

Jailer 2 is a Tamil-language action-comedy thriller, and the sequel to Rajinikanth's 2023 film Jailer. It is directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran's Sun Pictures, Koimoi and Filmibeat both report. Rajinikanth reprises his role as retired jailer Muthuvel Pandian, according to Filmibeat.

Koimoi lists the key cast as Rajinikanth, SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Ramya Krishnan and Vidya Balan. Filmibeat adds Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu and Mirnaa among those returning from the first film, and lists music by Anirudh Ravichander. The film was released theatrically on October 15, 2026, in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Hindi.

For readers deciding whether to catch it, the practical point is timing. Koimoi reports that Hindi shows have already fallen sharply, so Hindi-version screenings may be limited. The film's overall run, on the all-language figures reported so far, remains that of a major hit in total terms, even as this one dubbed version, by Koimoi's verdict system, finishes just below Hit.
